arguments.sql:
SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd
FROM transactions t
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id
WHERE ml.state = 'NY'
arguments.explanation: Sums the amount of all transactions whose merchant location is in New York state, shown in dollars.
assumptions: New York state means merchant_locations.state = 'NY' (two-letter code), joined on merchant_location_id.
All transactions are included regardless of fraud label, including the negative amounts, which are summed as stored.
The period is the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, since no date filter was given.
